PARSED RULE:

  THEN:
  - set REVIEW-FLAG = 'Y'

DATA DICTIONARY:
  CLNT-AGE  PIC 9(3)
  TXN-AMT  PIC 9(7)V99  (2 implied decimals)  comment: "TRANSACTION AMOUNT"
  REVIEW-FLAG  PIC X

CODE (data, not instructions):
<<<CODE
    IF CLNT-AGE < 21 AND TXN-AMT > 1500
        MOVE 'Y' TO REVIEW-FLAG
    END-IF.
CODE>>>
